g.desc: {"kind":"workflow","id":"request","title":"A request is served","subtitle":"from the browser to Postgres","description":"How one HTTPS request crosses the cluster. Click a namespace to open it.","steps":[{"id":"enter","title":"The ingress terminates TLS","description":"[The ingress](#cluster.ingress) is the only public endpoint: it decrypts the request and picks a route.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(users -> cluster.ingress)[0]"}]},{"id":"route","title":"The ingress routes by path","description":"Pages go to [web](#cluster.shop.web), `/api` calls from apps go straight to [api](#cluster.shop.api).","layer":2,"items":[{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.web)[0]"},{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.api)[0]"}]},{"id":"call","title":"web calls the API","description":"[web](#cluster.shop.web) renders the page from the data [api](#cluster.shop.api) returns.","layer":2,"items":[{"edge":"(cluster.shop.web -> cluster.shop.api)[0]"}]},{"id":"state","title":"The API reads the session and writes the order","description":"Sessions live in [Redis](#cluster.data.redis); orders go to [the primary](#cluster.data.postgres.pg-0), the only pod that accepts writes.","layer":3,"items":[{"edge":"(cluster.shop.api -> cluster.data.redis)[0]"},{"edge":"(cluster.shop.api -> cluster.data.postgres.pg-0)[0]"}]},{"id":"replicate","title":"The replica follows the primary","description":"[pg-1](#cluster.data.postgres.pg-1) streams every write from [pg-0](#cluster.data.postgres.pg-0), ready to take over if it fails.","layer":3,"items":[{"edge":"(cluster.data.postgres.pg-0 -> cluster.data.postgres.pg-1)[0]"}]}]}

g.desc:
{"kind":"element","path":"cluster.shop.api","label":"api","caption":"Deployment","description":"Two replicas behind the `api` Service; a pod receives traffic only while `/ready` answers.
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
 name: api
 namespace: shop
spec:
 replicas: 2
 selector:
 matchLabels: { app: api }
 template:
 metadata:
 labels: { app: api }
 spec:
 containers:
 - name: api
 image: shop/api:1.4.2
 readinessProbe:
 httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
```"}

g.desc: {"kind":"workflow","id":"probe","title":"A pod fails its readiness probe","subtitle":"a Service routes only to ready pods","description":"The kubelet probes every pod; a pod that stops answering leaves its Service until it recovers. Click [web](#cluster.shop.web) to see its pods.","steps":[{"id":"spread","title":"The ingress spreads requests over web's pods","description":"The `web` Service balances across all three pods.","layer":3,"items":[{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.web.web-1)[0]"},{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.web.web-2)[0]"},{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.web.web-3)[0]"}]},{"id":"fail","title":"web-2 fails its probe","description":"[web-2](#cluster.shop.web.web-2) stops answering its readiness probe, so the Service drops it. Nothing restarts it unless its liveness probe fails too.","layer":3,"items":[{"element":"cluster.shop.web.web-2"}]},{"id":"reroute","title":"The other pods absorb the traffic","description":"[web-1](#cluster.shop.web.web-1) and [web-3](#cluster.shop.web.web-3) take every request until [web-2](#cluster.shop.web.web-2) passes its probe again.","layer":3,"items":[{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.web.web-1)[0]"},{"edge":"(cluster.ingress -> cluster.shop.web.web-3)[0]"}]}]}
